resources.string: Photograph the label of a specific item, like your medication bottle. The alarm stops when the camera reads enough of that label\'s words.
Show every one of these items, in any order, to stop the alarm.
Choose or add at least one item before saving this alarm.

Hold the item so its label fills the white square. Tap Record and slowly turn the item for 5 seconds so the whole label is read, or take single photos. Only the words on the label are used; the background doesn\'t matter.
No text was read. Fill the square with the label, in good light, and hold steady.
Words this item will be recognized by
No word was read in more than one photo yet. Add more photos of the label.
Need at least 3 words, including one of 6 or more letters. Add photos of other parts of the label.
Recording… keep turning the item slowly.
Test it: show the label to the camera like you will when the alarm rings.
The item could not be saved.
That photo could not be processed. Try again. (%1$s)
The camera could not start. Close this screen and try again.
Needs new photos: items are now recognized by their label text. Tap the camera to retake.
%1$d alarm(s) use this item. It will be removed from them; an alarm left with no items will switch to the stop button.
